steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each planned area is placed by its volume source and whether matters sit behind it.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 2 plan items lack a volume source or a matter

findings.title: Work area with no volume source
findings.fix: Name the source of the volume

findings.title: Budget line with no matter behind it
findings.fix: Tie the budget to a matter or remove it

outcome.notChecked: Changes in the law not in the notes.
